import pandas as pd

# Read the input matrix
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Define the threshold
threshold = 0.30

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_count = df.isnull().sum()
missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)

# Create the missingness report
report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': df.columns,
    'missing_count': missing_count,
    'missing_rate': missing_rate,
    'kept': (missing_rate <= threshold).astype(int)
})

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_matrix = df[df['missing_rate'] <= threshold]

# Save the missingness report
report.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Save the selected matrix
selected_matrix.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)

print("Files generated successfully.")
</solution_file>
